title: Fidelity policy
description: Which viewports, states and content mode a comparison uses, and which corrections it may apply. Nothing unsupported can be enabled here: `allowAutomaticComponentCorrection` may only be false, because component-level cross-implementation matching is a permanent limitation (def_0030) rather than a feature awaiting a switch.

contentMode.description: Defaults to `independent-content`. Equivalent-content has six entry conditions that must be established from the captures rather than declared here; setting it only requests it.

pixelComparison.description: Never `always`. In independent-content mode comparative pixel work is DISABLED rather than thresholded, because different copy produces clusters that are not defects — 42 of them in the Phase 3.4 slice.

thresholdProfile.description: One value, named for what it is. No measured tolerance is validated; two of seventeen calibrated entries are, and both are finite policies rather than numeric thresholds. A profile called `calibrated` or `strict` would imply evidence that does not exist.

allowAutomaticGlobalValueCorrection.description: Global token values only, and off by default.

allowAutomaticComponentCorrection.description: May only be false. def_0030 is a permanent limitation: two independent implementation pairs both failed a recall bar that was not moved.
